description: Vaxtex Cotfab Limited manufactures and sells textile products in India. The company processes and trades in suiting, shirting, and denim fabrics made from cotton and polyester blends, as well as fabrics with specialized finishes, including pigment and reactive dyeing. It also provides denim fabrics, home textiles, jeans, men's casual shirts, printed fabrics, and yarns. The company serves international brands, export houses, corporate buyers, domestic traders, wholesalers, and distributors. Vaxtex Cotfab Limited was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
